# Viet Air Filter (VAF)

Viet Air Filter (VAF) is a Vietnamese manufacturer of industrial air filters, HEPA/ULPA filters, HVAC filtration products, and cleanroom equipment.

- [Home](https://www.vietfil.com/)

## Key Topics

- HEPA filters
- ULPA filters
- Pre-filters
- Fine filters
- HVAC air filtration
- Cleanroom equipment
- FFU
- HEPA Box
- Air Shower
- Pass Box
- ISO 16890
- EN 1822
- ISO 14644

## Company Focus

VAF provides air filtration and cleanroom solutions for electronics, semiconductor, pharmaceutical, healthcare, food, and industrial facilities.
